autonomy.title: How much should the agent do on its own?
autonomy.body: It currently finds work every night and changes nothing, because nobody has answered this yet. Every change it makes is logged with the previous value and can be undone in one click. You can change this any time in agent settings.

suggest.hint: Finds everything, changes nothing. You apply what you agree with.

apply_all.label: Do it all
apply_all.hint: Applies everything it proposes, including wording. You review after the fact.
apply_all.description: Applies everything it proposes, including rewrites that are a matter of judgement. Still logged, still reversible, but you'll be reviewing after the fact rather than before.

googleSetup.descSignIn: One click. Read-only access to Search Console + Analytics. Skippable: the rest of the app works without it.
googleSetup.descSetup: One-time setup. The same connection serves every client. Skippable: the rest of the app works without it.
googleSetup.bullet1: Real keyword positions from Google itself, not scraped.
googleSetup.how1: 1. One-time: create an OAuth app in Google Cloud (~3 min, free). You'll paste a Client ID + Secret here.
googleSetup.how2: 2. One-time: log in with the Google account that has access to your GSC properties.
googleSetup.how3: 3. Per client: pick the GSC property + GA4 property from a dropdown.
googleSetup.step3: 3. Configure OAuth consent screen (External, add yourself as Test User)
googleSetup.step4: 4. Create OAuth Client ID (Web application). Paste this redirect URI:
googleSetup.connectEnv: Click below. A new window opens for Google to ask which account you want to use and to grant read-only access to Search Console + Analytics.
googleSetup.connectOwn: Click Connect Google. A new window opens for you to sign in. Pick the Google account that has access to your Search Console + Analytics properties. Grant read access, and you're done.
googleSetup.headsUp: Heads up: Google shows a “this app isn't verified” warning while your project is in test mode. Click Advanced → Go to [your project]. This is normal for personal/local apps.
googleSetup.doneText: Now go to any client's detail page and pick the matching Search Console property and GA4 property from the dropdowns. The same Google login covers every client: you just pick the right property each time.
